description: This file defines the 'Condition' class used for building and managing query conditions in Drupal's database abstraction layer. It includes methods for adding conditions, compiling SQL fragments, and handling condition operators.

classes.name: Condition
classes.description: Represents a set of conditions for a database query, supporting complex condition groups, compilation to SQL, and operator handling.

methods.name: condition
methods.description: Adds a condition to the set, with validation for operators and values.

methods.name: where
methods.description: Adds a raw condition snippet to the set.

methods.name: isNull
methods.description: Adds an IS NULL condition for a field.

methods.name: isNotNull
methods.description: Adds an IS NOT NULL condition for a field.

methods.name: notExists
methods.description: Adds a NOT EXISTS subquery condition.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the set of conditions into a SQL string and arguments, handling operators and subqueries.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the string version of the compiled conditions.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Clones the condition object, including nested conditions.

methods.name: mapConditionOperator
methods.description: Provides extra processing directives for specific operators.
